events.verdict: Payton II (GSW) makes clean contact with the ball and the ensuing body contact with DiVincenzo (MIN) is incidental.
Reid (MIN) is in a legal guarding position when he cleanly blocks Wiggins' (GSW) driving shot attempt. The body contact between the two players is incidental.
Hield (GSW) reaches for the ball and initiates more than marginal contact with Reid's (MIN) left arm.
Jackson-Davis (GSW) brings his arm across Gobert (MIN), but the contact is marginal and he is able to move freely.
DiVincenzo (MIN) briefly gets his hand on the ball before Santos (GSW) gains full control. Any contact that occurs is incidental.
DiVincenzo (MIN) initiates illegal contact with Santos (GSW) as he reaches for the ball.
McDaniels (MIN) delivers contact to Wiggins (GSW) that dislodges him from his legally established screening position.
McDaniels (MIN) dislodges the ball away from Wiggins (GSW) and the contact that occurs is incidental hand on ball contact.
The ball is last touched by Minnesota before going out of bounds.
Moody (GSW) attempts to slow down as he receives the pass and begins losing his balance on his own accord. There is no illegal contact by Gobert (MIN).

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Payton II (GSW) does not establish himself in bounds prior to making contact with the ball.
Payton II (GSW) cleanly blocks DiVincenzo's (MIN) shot attempt before the ball touches the backboard.
DiVincenzo (MIN) commits a take foul on Payton II (GSW).
McDaniels (MIN) commits a take foul on Curry (GSW).
Golden State signals for and is awarded a timeout prior to the expiration of the game clock. After communicating with the Replay Center, the game clock is reset to 00:01.0.
